title: Ukraine claims sea drone attack on Russian patrol ship Sergey Kotov
body:
On 5 March 2024 Ukraine's military intelligence service, known as GUR, said that its special unit Group 13 had struck the Russian patrol ship Sergey Kotov with drones overnight near the Kerch Strait, between Crimea and Russia. GUR said the ship, reportedly worth 65 million US dollars, had been sunk, and posted grainy video that it said showed the vessel going down. It said the attack caused damage to the stern and to the starboard and port sides.

GUR spokesman Andriy Yusov said the strike left some crew members dead and wounded, though some were likely evacuated. Russia's defence ministry had not officially responded at the time of the report. The Sergey Kotov had been attacked before, but this time the damage was described as critical.

The strike followed other Ukrainian attacks on the Russian Black Sea Fleet in February 2024. The landing ship Caesar Kunikov was hit off the southern coast of Crimea, and later that month the missile-armed corvette Ivanovets was shown on Ukrainian footage sinking stern-first after an underwater drone attack. The fleet is based in Sevastopol, Crimea. Al Jazeera reported that Ukraine's attacks had pushed Russian ships out of western Black Sea waters, helping to reopen a key export route.
